name: Nike
source:
In 2526 pilot Nike (22) with co-pilot girl Miho (17) are participating in interstellar space race after winning the race the previous year. However the princess of the host planet Athena got kidnapped and Nike is going to search for Athena while participating in the race.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2526年，22岁的飞行员奈基与17岁的少女副驾驶美步铃参加星际竞速赛。两人在上一届比赛中夺得冠军，本次本想再次一展身手，主办行星的公主雅典娜却遭人绑架。奈基只得一边参赛，一边寻找雅典娜。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
